The tungsten weighting isn’t there for show. It lets us tune the face orientation. In this configuration, that’s exactly what gives the putter its zero torque character. For future customs - we can also adjust the weighting to achieve a neutral torque setup.

Up front, we’ve gone with a copper insert to keep the feel soft, solid, and exactly how a putter like this should sound off the face.
